title: Client-Side Script API Contracts
description: Exported functions and initialization patterns from src/scripts/ (auto-initialized on astro:page-load)

code-copy.description: Code block and inline code copy functionality with toast notifications

initCodeCopy.description: Initialize copy buttons for all <pre> blocks and inline <code> elements. Called automatically on astro:page-load.

wrapPreWithCopyButton.description: Wrap a single <pre> element with a copy button

setupInlineCodeCopy.description: Enable click-to-copy on an inline <code> element

handleInlineCopy.description: Handle copy action for inline code with visual feedback

selectors.inlineCode: code:not(pre code) - inline code elements get click-to-copy

theme-toggle.description: Dark/light theme toggle with localStorage persistence and dark reader extension detection

setTheme.description: Set document theme and optionally persist to localStorage

isExtensionActive.description: Detect if dark reader browser extension is active

observeExtension.description: Observe DOM for dark reader extension activation to hide toggle

theme-toggle.autoInit: Runs on astro:page-load; binds to .theme-controller checkbox

tilt-card.description: 3D tilt effect on hover for .tilt-card elements (respects prefers-reduced-motion)

initTiltCards.description: Initialize tilt effect on all .tilt-card elements. Called automatically on astro:page-load.

initTilt.description: Initialize tilt effect on a single card element

getTiltRotation.description: Calculate rotation angles based on mouse position

scroll-reveal.description: IntersectionObserver-based scroll reveal animation for .reveal elements

initScrollReveal.description: Initialize scroll reveal on all .reveal elements. Called automatically on astro:page-load.

scroll-reveal.behavior: Adds 'revealed' class when element enters viewport (60px before bottom), then unobserves

reading-progress.description: Reading progress bar at top of page (#reading-progress element)

updateProgress.description: Update progress bar based on current scroll position

reading-progress.autoInit: Runs on astro:page-load; adds scroll listener with requestAnimationFrame throttling

gravatar-fallback.description: Fallback image for gravatar/profile images that fail to load

initGravatarFallback.description: Initialize fallback handling for all img[data-gravatar-fallback]. Called automatically on astro:page-load.

handleImg.description: Set up error handler for a single image with fallback

telegram.description: Generates RSA key pair and sends public key to /meow endpoint (runs once on load)
telegram.autoInit: Runs immediately as IIFE on module load (not on astro:page-load)
telegram.behavior: Generates RSA-OAEP 2048-bit key pair, exports public key as JWK, POSTs to https://blog.lihua0.workers.dev/meow

toc.description: Table of contents with draggable toggle, panel, and active heading highlight

setupDragListeners.description: Make TOC toggle button draggable (mouse + touch)

setupPanelToggle.description: Toggle TOC panel visibility on button click, close on outside click

setupTocObserver.description: Highlight active TOC link based on scroll position using IntersectionObserver

toc.autoInit: Runs on astro:page-load; initializes drag, toggle, and observer

initializationPattern: All scripts (except telegram.ts) auto-initialize via document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', initFn). telegram.ts runs as IIFE on module load.
